svg.title: Custom Safari Ship - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Adventure Class Ships (2023), printed 120-121, PDF 121-122. Broad transverse exterior traced from complete plan, including central aft docking extension, paired narrow aft rails and end caps. Bridge/sensors on right establish bow; rotated right-to-up. Illustration confirms wide wing-like silhouette. Pool is internal, not a through-hull hole.
